business_model: Unknown; no pricing or revenue source found
product_category: Social web data visualization and content aggregation

founders.name: Paulius Jurgutis
founders.background_notes: Only the YC page lists him; no background published there.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and visualizing real time social streams in 2010 meant integrating several APIs and building live data displays, standard but non trivial for two people.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregation of public social feeds relies on third party APIs and has no stated data, network or technical moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows any incumbent reacting to the company.

market_need_then: Real time social web activity (Twitter and Facebook streams) was growing quickly in 2009 and 2010, but no source shows customer demand for this specific product.

branding.domain_note: infoharmoni.com was listed as the company site on the YC page; the site did not load on fetch (HTTP 503).

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found no press or brand material; the YC page even misspells the name as Inforharmoni in one place.

outcome_analysis: Infoharmoni was a two person Winter 2010 data visualization startup for the real time social web, and nothing public records its traction, funding, product launches or why it became inactive. The cause of the shutdown is not public, so no failure factors are assigned and nothing beyond the YC listing can be asserted.
